scope: scripts/qualify_typed_graphical.py, engineering-only, typed-insert-first-lad and typed-insert-first-fbd: a first network inserted into a network-free FB derived from the native Tgp_Boolean exports. The builder placed the compile unit, with a captured native network envelope, directly before the block title and shifted the title IDs by the inserted count; the independent check required that placement and the exact shift, and the topology matched the native Boolean network. Both passed import/compile, complete prepared-vs-native XML, save and fresh reopen, and checkpoint restore with recovered reopen.
limitations: Engineering only; insertion combined with storage creation still needs its own composite effect contract.
An earlier attempt (artifacts/rt6-envelope-mismatch) failed NativePreservationMismatch with a bare envelope; it showed TIA adds the network's own comment/title objects.
